| worst_mdd | **-9.31%** | -11.18% | Champion |

**Status**: Champion holds. The candidate (`exp_macro_alpha_shadow`) showed better lockbox robustness (min 1.35 vs 1.13) but weaker tuning performance and deeper drawdown (-11.2% vs -9.3%).

```bash

    --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
    --run --select-best

# 2. System-level candidate generation

    --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
    --run

# 3. Generate fix recommendations report
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
    --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
    --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

---

- `run all` — Execute all 3 commands sequentially
- `run 1/2/3` — Execute specific command
- `analyze` — Deep-dive on champion vs candidate trade-offs
- `review registry` — Inspect module_registry.yaml before running
